=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:30182-30190 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The `RB_TARGET_MERGED` no-change branch runs before the new incomplete-context `elif`, so on an already-merged PR with incomplete comment context it still removes `ai:review-blocked` and reports success.
  WHY: Severity disagreement: sonnet-5_5 and glm-5_3-flash rated it NIT, while gemini, minimax and gpt-6-luna rated it MAJOR. Taking the highest of these reported ratings gives MAJOR, so the "critical" shown on this line is unsupported by the sources. Treat the effective severity as MAJOR (the ledger's enum has no major, so it maps to "high"). The outcome withholds nothing, since the success status and label removal depend on comments the poller may be missing.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:29068-29075 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: A `jq` transform failure after a successful paginated `gh api` read is logged as `issue_comments_read_failed` or `review_comments_read_failed`.
  WHY: The deferral is still safe, but the logged reason misleads operators into investigating the API call. All reviewers rated it NIT.
- changelog.d/8908-poller-rb-judge-incomplete-context.md:2 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The changelog says the deferral happens without posting a judge comment or relabelling. A non-final `fix` still posts the judge comment at scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:29773-29774, and the merged-PR path removes the label.
  WHY: The documentation overstates what is withheld. The behavior itself is safe, and all reviewers rated it NIT.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:30184-30189 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: `RB_SKIP_RETRY_INCREMENT="true"` is set in the deferral `elif` with no unset, so a stale value could leak into later iterations.
  WHY: Two other reviewers (sonnet-5_5, glm-5_3-flash) checked this and found line 29943 resets the variable to "false", so the concern is likely refuted. All reviewers rated it NIT.
- changelog.d/8908-poller-rb-judge-incomplete-context.md:2 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The changelog entry does not follow the required §20.D structure.
  WHY: It merges headline and lead into one sentence and lacks the "Numbers that matter" and audience-closing sections. Rated NIT.

- requirement: "Withhold every merge-enabling outcome of this rb-judge evaluation for this tick: merge, auto-merge, ready-to-merge labelling and success statuses."

  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: The `RB_TARGET_MERGED` branch at 30182-30186 precedes the new `elif` at 30187 and is unguarded, so it still removes `ai:review-blocked` and sends the success notification. For a non-final `fix`, the judge comment at 29773-29774 is also still posted. Severity disagreement: sonnet-5_5 NIT, minimax and gpt-6-luna MAJOR.
- requirement: "Withhold ... auto-merge ..." (auto-merge not covered by the gate)
  expected_change_site: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh main merge gate (case "${RB_ACTION}" in)
  confidence=2
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  EVIDENCE: The gate only checks `merge|merge_with_followup` and does not withhold auto-merge actions. Severity MAJOR. Sonnet-5_5 and glm-5_3-flash say auto-merge is not a distinct judge action, so there is no gap.
- requirement: Issue bullet "Add a test, tests/test_poller_rb_judge_incomplete_context.py ... incomplete context defers the merge ... a complete context is unchanged." The no-fix merge-path guard should be verified by a runtime test.
  expected_change_site: tests/test_poller_rb_judge_incomplete_context.py::test_poller_rb_incomplete_no_fix_merge_path_is_guarded
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: The test makes only static placement assertions and never runs the `elif` with `RB_TARGET_MERGED=true`, so no test catches the unreachable-deferral bug. NIT.
- requirement: "Stay inside files_touched. ... append-only edits and no reflow."
  expected_change_site: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh around lines 29068-29079
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: The two single-line legacy assignments were each replaced with about seven lines, which reflows the inline branch. Sonnet-5_5 and glm-5_3-flash judged the split necessary to capture the exit status and compliant. NIT.
- requirement: §20.D changelog structure (Headline, Lead paragraph, Numbers that matter, Audience closing, For contributors)
  expected_change_site: changelog.d/8908-poller-rb-judge-incomplete-context.md
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The fragment is a single bold-led bullet with no Numbers table, audience closing or contributors section. NIT. Sonnet-5_5 judged this is not a requirement of issue #8908.
- requirement: Changelog should accurately describe the shipped deferral behavior.
  expected_change_site: changelog.d/8908-poller-rb-judge-incomplete-context.md
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: The judge comment is still posted at scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:29773-29774, and relabelling and the success notification fire at 30182-30186. NIT.
